title: myBlend expands its beauty tech offering with Nuon Medical
summary: Barely a year after the launch of myLIFTINGroller and a new LED mask model, French skincare brand myBlend is expanding its ecosystem of beauty tech tools focused on skincare with two new devices: myBLEMISHpen and myDARKSPOTpen. myBLEMISHpen targets skin imperfections using the effectiveness of blue light, while myDARKSPOTpen targets dark spots using green light. myBLEMISHpen is inspired by dermatological protocols, combining the power of blue light and red light together with...
